purpose: User-authorized broader search for a stable NASDAQ-100 model exceeding SPY and competing models
data: Existing hash-reviewed historical NASDAQ-100 daily economic panel and Alpaca regular-session features, 2018-2025; all previously viewed years remain exploratory
training_origins: Every eligible daily signal with complete five-session target; purge target maturities before prior-year validation and test boundaries; test portfolios retain the original five-session schedule
features: Causal 1/5/10/21/63/126/252-session returns and QQQ-relative returns; 5/20/50/200 moving-average distances; 20/60/126 volatility, downside volatility, 63/252 drawdown, relative dollar volume and lagged shrunk QQQ beta; lagged market trend/risk context; cross-sectional trend ranks; intraday view adds current/5/20-session summaries with explicit coverage
normalization: Training-eligible observations only, missing values imputed to training means, standard deviation floor and clipping; both views have identical dimensions with intraday channels padded for daily controls
network: Shared local MLP, masked mean market context, shared head; no ticker IDs or node-specific parameters; permutation-equivariant and supports variable security count
training_loss: Date-balanced raw or QQQ-beta-residual MSE in percentage points; same causal beta definition as the completed target experiment
selection_score: Prior-year validation residual RankIC by signal, aggregated by month: median monthly mean minus 0.25 times its population standard deviation; no portfolio test metric used for iterations, epochs, penalties, family or feature selection
ensemble: Equal eligible-stock rank average across five seeds for trees/network; deterministic single ridge forecast
primary_candidate: For each annual fold, equal rank blend of the three cells with highest ensemble validation stability score; stable ties follow views, targets and families in protocol order
selector_controls: equal blend of all twelve cells
portfolio: Fixed equal top 10, same reviewed continuous $1m accounts, next-close frozen-share execution, transaction costs and 1% ADV caps
risk_rule: Full stock exposure when signal-close QQQ is at or above its trailing 200-session moving average; 50% stock exposure plus cash otherwise. No leverage, zero cash interest. Apply identically to every model and to a QQQ timing control; portfolio-size and risk parameters never selected from test performance.
historical_reliability_screen: For the primary validation-selected blend: CAGR above SPY at base and double costs; at least three of four annual returns above SPY; at least 28 of 48 months above SPY; maximum drawdown no more than five percentage points worse than SPY; report matched seed blends and every competing model regardless of pass/fail. This screen is development evidence, not a statistical guarantee.
inference: 10000 joint circular-block resamples, 5/20/60-session sensitivity. Primary 20. For both primary risk policies compare paired daily active means against SPY, QQQ and each of the twelve base models under the same risk policy (28 contrasts total), with one simultaneous max-statistic diagnostic. Fixed fitted-path inference, no correction for all prior research or training uncertainty.
fit_inventory: 16 ridge fold/cell selections across three penalties (48 candidate coefficient fits), 80 boosted-tree fits and 80 shared-network fits; 176 selected fold models. Record every stage and trial before financial evaluation.
stop_rule: Freeze code, features, input hashes and finite family before fitting. Lock all four annual family-selection records before any new financial test metrics. Disclose all cells, policies, seeds, cost stresses and negative findings. Further development batches require a new versioned protocol and an append-only research ledger.
confirmation: The reserved future-date plan from ndx_ranking_20261020 remains separate. No current historical result is untouched confirmation. A reliable future-outperformance claim cannot be guaranteed by continuing to search observed years.
